books.title: The River That Remembers Names
books.author: Maya Sasmita
books.coverAlt: Cover of The River That Remembers Names
books.description: A literary novel about memory, migration, and a riverside town learning to hear its past.
books.cardDescription: A riverside story of memory, migration, and belonging.
about: After years away, Laras returns to a town whose river seems to remember more than its people do.
The novel follows family stories, changing landscapes, and the names that survive in everyday speech.
books.quote: A place forgets slowly, one name at a time.
highlights: Themes of memory, place, and belonging

id.title: Sungai yang Mengingat Nama
id.description: Novel sastra tentang ingatan, migrasi, dan sebuah kota tepian sungai yang belajar mendengar masa lalunya.
id.cardDescription: Kisah tepian sungai tentang ingatan, migrasi, dan rasa memiliki.
about: Setelah bertahun-tahun pergi, Laras kembali ke kota yang sungainya seolah mengingat lebih banyak daripada penduduknya.
Novel ini mengikuti kisah keluarga, perubahan lanskap, dan nama-nama yang bertahan dalam percakapan sehari-hari.
id.quote: Sebuah tempat melupa perlahan, satu nama pada satu waktu.
highlights: Fiksi sastra yang berpusat pada karakter
Tema ingatan, tempat, dan rasa memiliki

ms.title: Sungai yang Mengingati Nama
ms.description: Novel sastera tentang ingatan, penghijrahan, dan sebuah pekan tepi sungai yang belajar mendengar masa lalunya.
ms.cardDescription: Kisah tepi sungai tentang ingatan, penghijrahan, dan rasa kepunyaan.
about: Selepas bertahun-tahun pergi, Laras kembali ke pekan yang sungainya seolah-olah mengingati lebih banyak daripada penduduknya.
Novel ini mengikuti kisah keluarga, perubahan landskap, dan nama-nama yang kekal dalam pertuturan harian.
ms.quote: Sebuah tempat lupa perlahan-lahan, satu nama pada satu masa.
highlights: Tema ingatan, tempat, dan rasa kepunyaan
ms.coverAlt: Kulit buku Sungai yang Mengingati Nama

books.title: Letters from the Rain Season
books.author: Raka Pranata
books.coverAlt: Cover of Letters from the Rain Season
books.description: Twelve stories about distance, family, and messages that arrive too late.
books.cardDescription: Twelve quiet stories of distance, family, and delayed words.
about: These stories move between small towns, rented rooms, and journeys home.
Each letter changes how its recipient understands an ordinary life.
books.quote: Some messages need a season before they can be read.

books.title: Small Lights After Dusk
books.author: Nadia Rahmani
books.coverAlt: Cover of Small Lights After Dusk
books.description: A poetry collection tracing care, grief, and the small rituals that keep hope visible.
books.cardDescription: Poems of care, grief, ritual, and stubborn hope.
about: The collection observes intimate gestures at the edge of day.
Its poems find brightness in kitchens, gardens, roads, and remembered voices.
books.quote: Evening does not erase the lamp; it teaches us to notice it.
